name: json2dir-aot
description: C# compiled with .NET 8 Native AOT, hand-written JSON parser
build:
export DOTNET_ROOT={runtimes}/dotnet-8.0.425 NUGET_PACKAGES={runtimes}/dotnet-8.0.425/nuget-packages DOTNET_CLI_HOME={runtimes}/dotnet-8.0.425/home DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT=1 DOTNET_NOLOGO=1 DOTNET_SKIP_FIRST_TIME_EXPERIENCE=1
# Native AOT links with the system clang and zlib.
{runtimes}/dotnet-8.0.425/dotnet publish -c Release -r linux-x64 --nologo -v quiet -o {src}/out {src}/json2dir.csproj
